name: Golden Coconut Chicken Curry
ingredients: 3 tbsp coconut oil, vegetable or canola oil
500g (1 lb) chicken thigh fillets, cut into 1cm slices
1 large head broccoli, florets cut small (4 heaped cups)
3 tsp turmeric, finely grated (or 1 1/2 tsp powder)
1 cup coriander/cilantro leaves, lightly packed, plus extra
Jasmine or basmati rice (for serving - omit for low-carb)
unmapped: coconut cream (board has coconut-milk-canned; cream may substitute)
why: 517 cal / 16g carbs / 27g protein CURRY-ONLY (rice excluded) lands dead center of the 400-650, <=35g band. Structurally low-carb: chicken thighs + coconut cream + broccoli, no rice/potato/legume base. Simmered braise, batch-friendly at 14. Distinct from catalog's other coconut chicken curries (kuku paka, cape malay). Verified from published nutrition on page.
